scope: One nominated original-face CPU-only selection and unchanged dominant-normal UV qualification; no reselection, bake, GLB, Blender, WSL, model or GPU execution.

synthetic_tests.provenance: Read root-produced focused-tests.txt; reviewer did not rerun tests or any actual source selection.

verified_checks: Exact approved base and isolated branch; every reused source byte-matches Git base.
Nomination [346,393,393,436] is frozen by exact SHA256 before any new actual geometry count; strictly within prior [332,384,400,448]; no parameter search.

Historical nearest +X centre-depth selector unchanged except module ROI; selects complete original faces and one original-edge ring among complete same-ROI faces; 6000 admission fails closed without truncation or retry.
Durable selection admission, exact face/vertex IDs, original corner bits, material coordinate ordering, and NPY byte-exact readback precede the layout gate.
Topology counts edge and vertex components separately, global original-edge incidence by bounded full-source chunks, and artificial versus natural local boundary edges.
Leaf/vine window coverage is explicitly a projected footprint proxy, never semantic or nearest-depth segmentation; private visual readback remains required for representation.
Historical dominant-normal axis projection, fixed 4096*sqrt(3)*(1+1e-6) density and one 32-aligned shelf pass are reused without source edits.
Bounded 1024 atlas, 6000 faces, 256 islands, 250000 clipping tests and 64Mi raster bbox work per phase remain enforced by pinned primitives.

F64 and portable F32 positive area, tangent-density floor 4096, analytic overlap, every-face centre coverage and continuous LOD0..5 positive box/trilinear ancestry isolation fail closed; half-LODs add no ancestors beyond their two adjacent integer levels.

Owned supervisor retains 6GiB process commit, 180s deadline, 12GiB RAM and 2GiB disk floors, exclusive marker/output, attached-before-binary-GO, natural owned Job exit verification and before/after source identity watch.
Sources compile without execution; all operational Python launches require -I -B and bytecode disabled before subsequent imports.
limitations: GO authorizes only this one qualification attempt; actual selection representation and UV outcome remain unmeasured.
Selected visible front crop is not a complete closed anatomical leaf or vine; proxy overlap alone cannot establish visual identity.
A failed deterministic packing/coverage candidate is not proof that all UV layouts or foliage atlases are infeasible.
No foliage material-quality result is produced by this selection/UV-only experiment.
